summary: Tested KT-V520 remote-print feature end-to-end. Backend pytest 5/5 pass: (1) POST /api/kiosk/printers/register with kiosk session returns {printer_id,name,device_token}; without session -> 401. (2) GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/settings/kiosk-printers works as admin; rename empty -> 400, delete unknown -> 404; after delete the row disappears. (3) WS /api/kiosk/ws printer-role with invalid token closes 4401. (4) Full flow: offline printer_id -> 409; after printer connects (printer_ready), admin WS presence contains printers[]; POST remote-print -> job_id; printer WS receives {type:REMOTE_PRINT,job_id,payment_id,data:{lines:[...]}}; printer replies REMOTE_PRINT_DONE ok -> admin WS receives REMOTE_PRINT_DONE with printer name; db.kiosk_print_log.admin_printed_at persisted. (5) After DELETE /api/settings/kiosk-printers/{id}, printer WS auth with same device_token closes 4401. Frontend: Instellingen -> Kiosk apparaten section (/<slug>/admin/instellingen#kiosk-apparaten) renders data-testid=kiosk-devices and data-testid=kiosk-printers. Registered 2 printers via API, both appeared as rows with offline dot (last_seen=0) and 'Offline' label; kiosk-printer-rename-{id} opened a browser prompt and renamed row to 'TEST_UI Printer A (renamed)'. kiosk-printer-remove-{id} button is present (confirm-dialog flow). Preview-DB cleaned (all TEST_ printers deleted via API after test).
critical_code_review_comments: KtpPrintButton timeout (20s) uses setTimeout; if the printer later replies DONE after timeout, the admin WS still updates kiosk_print_log.admin_printed_at but the status bubble already shows 'Geen antwoord van ...'. Consider reconciling late DONE events via subscribeKioskLive (prints version bump already triggers a refresh of the list, so this is minor).
KioskPrintsOverlay POLL_MS=15000 + queuePrint 2s debounce means a successful remote print may take up to ~2s to show the 'Afgedrukt' badge; acceptable.

kiosk_remote_print requires kiosk session (cookie kiosk_token); the admin triggers it from inside the kiosk overlay so this works. Good: admin without active kiosk session cannot bypass to trigger prints.
_online_printers list is derived from last_seen>now-_PRESENCE_TTL_S; on WS close printer.last_seen is reset to 0 so admin presence updates correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on admin Kiosk apparaten (list render + rename). KioskPrintsOverlay KT button not directly UI-tested (requires live kiosk admin session), but the entire WS flow driving it is verified end-to-end in the backend pytest.
